name: 05 · Present perfect continuous · Normal
description: 30 preguntas para explicar investigaciones en curso, duración, actividad reciente y efectos visibles mediante have/has been + -ing.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Ongoing investigation
questions.question: We ___ this alert since 08:30, and the investigation is still open.
questions.explanation: La investigación empezó a las 08:30 y continúa ahora; usamos have been investigating con since.
questions.translation: Llevamos investigando esta alerta desde las 08:30 y la investigación sigue abierta.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Duration · since / for
questions.question: Our analysts ___ the authentication logs for the last two hours.
questions.explanation: For the last two hours expresa una duración que llega hasta ahora; con sujeto plural usamos have been reviewing.
questions.translation: Nuestros analistas llevan revisando los logs de autenticación durante las últimas dos horas.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Ongoing investigation
questions.question: The SOC ___ the affected account since the password reset.
questions.explanation: The SOC es singular y la monitorización comenzó tras el cambio de contraseña y continúa; usamos has been monitoring.
questions.translation: El SOC lleva monitorizando la cuenta afectada desde el restablecimiento de la contraseña.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Client questions and updates
questions.question: How long ___ repeated connection failures on the server?
questions.explanation: Para preguntar por la duración de una situación que continúa usamos How long have you been + verbo en -ing.
questions.translation: ¿Cuánto tiempo lleváis observando fallos de conexión repetidos en el servidor?

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Duration · since / for
questions.question: We ___ with your network team all morning to validate the firewall changes.
questions.explanation: All morning destaca la duración de una colaboración que sigue en curso; usamos have been working.
questions.translation: Llevamos toda la mañana trabajando con vuestro equipo de redes para validar los cambios del firewall.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Repeated activity and monitoring
questions.question: The endpoint ___ DNS requests to the same suspicious domain for twenty minutes.
questions.explanation: La actividad se ha repetido durante veinte minutos y sigue siendo relevante; con endpoint usamos has been sending.
questions.translation: El endpoint lleva veinte minutos enviando solicitudes DNS al mismo dominio sospechoso.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Negatives
questions.question: We ___ any new alerts since we applied the block.
questions.explanation: La ausencia de alertas se extiende desde el bloqueo hasta ahora; con we usamos haven't been receiving.
questions.translation: No hemos estado recibiendo nuevas alertas desde que aplicamos el bloqueo.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Client questions and updates
questions.question: The customer ___ for status updates every hour.
questions.explanation: La petición se repite durante un periodo reciente; con customer usamos has been asking.
questions.translation: El cliente lleva pidiendo actualizaciones de estado cada hora.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Client questions and updates
questions.question: I ___ the incident summary for our next call.
questions.explanation: Se presenta la preparación como una actividad reciente o todavía en curso; con I usamos have been preparing.
questions.translation: He estado preparando el resumen del incidente para nuestra próxima llamada.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Ongoing investigation
questions.question: Our threat hunters ___ for related indicators across the environment since noon.
questions.explanation: Since noon marca el inicio de una búsqueda que continúa; con sujeto plural usamos have been looking.
questions.translation: Nuestros threat hunters llevan buscando indicadores relacionados en todo el entorno desde el mediodía.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Repeated activity and monitoring
questions.question: Traffic volumes ___ since the new rule was deployed.
questions.explanation: Traffic volumes es plural y describe una tendencia iniciada en el pasado que continúa; usamos have been increasing.
questions.translation: Los volúmenes de tráfico llevan aumentando desde que se desplegó la nueva regla.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Recent activity · visible effects
questions.question: Why is the service slow? Several hosts ___ a large number of requests.
questions.explanation: La lentitud actual es un efecto visible de una actividad reciente y repetida; usamos have been generating.
questions.translation: ¿Por qué va lento el servicio? Varios hosts han estado generando un gran número de solicitudes.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Duration · since / for
questions.question: The investigation ___ longer than expected because some logs are incomplete.
questions.explanation: La investigación sigue en curso y su duración se prolonga; con sujeto singular usamos has been taking.
questions.translation: La investigación está llevando más tiempo de lo esperado porque algunos logs están incompletos.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Duration · since / for
questions.question: We ___ for the customer's confirmation for forty-five minutes.
questions.explanation: For forty-five minutes expresa duración hasta el presente; con we usamos have been waiting.
questions.translation: Llevamos cuarenta y cinco minutos esperando la confirmación del cliente.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Result vs process
questions.question: Choose the natural sentence for an analysis that started earlier and is still in progress.
options: We are analyzing the logs since 09:00.
We have been analyzing the logs since 09:00.
We have analyzed the logs at 09:00.
questions.explanation: Para una actividad que empezó a las 09:00 y aún continúa, la forma natural es have been analyzing ... since 09:00.
questions.translation: Llevamos analizando los logs desde las 09:00.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · SOC improvement work
questions.question: The detection team ___ the rule all week to reduce false positives.
questions.explanation: The detection team funciona aquí como sujeto singular y all week destaca continuidad; usamos has been tuning.
questions.translation: El equipo de detección lleva toda la semana ajustando la regla para reducir los falsos positivos.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Ongoing investigation
questions.question: Since 10:00, we ___ outbound connections from the affected subnet.
questions.explanation: Since 10:00 fija el punto de inicio de una actividad que continúa; usamos have been tracking.
questions.translation: Desde las 10:00 llevamos rastreando conexiones salientes de la subred afectada.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Duration · since / for
questions.question: How long ___ the forensic scan ___?
questions.explanation: Con scan, sujeto singular, preguntamos por duración con How long has ... been running?
questions.translation: ¿Cuánto tiempo lleva ejecutándose el análisis forense?

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Ongoing investigation
questions.question: The malware ___ to contact its command-and-control server since execution.
questions.explanation: La conducta empezó al ejecutarse y sigue repitiéndose; con malware usamos has been trying.
questions.translation: El malware lleva intentando contactar con su servidor de mando y control desde que se ejecutó.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Ongoing investigation
questions.question: We ___ whether the activity is linked to the earlier phishing campaign.
questions.explanation: La comprobación se presenta como un proceso reciente o aún abierto; con we usamos have been checking.
questions.translation: Hemos estado comprobando si la actividad está relacionada con la campaña de phishing anterior.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Recent activity · visible effects
questions.question: Our engineers ___ volatile data, so some endpoints may respond more slowly.
questions.explanation: La lentitud actual es consecuencia de una actividad reciente; usamos have been collecting.
questions.translation: Nuestros ingenieros han estado recopilando datos volátiles, por lo que algunos endpoints pueden responder más lentamente.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Repeated activity and monitoring
questions.question: The SIEM ___ events since the storage issue began.
questions.explanation: Since the storage issue began conecta el inicio pasado con un problema que continúa; con SIEM usamos has been dropping.
questions.translation: El SIEM lleva perdiendo eventos desde que comenzó el problema de almacenamiento.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Client questions and updates
questions.question: ___ you ___ our status notifications since the incident began?
questions.explanation: Preguntamos por una recepción repetida desde un punto pasado hasta ahora: Have you been receiving...?
questions.translation: ¿Habéis estado recibiendo nuestras notificaciones de estado desde que comenzó el incidente?

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Repeated activity and monitoring
questions.question: The audit logs ___ suspicious sign-in attempts for the last three days.
questions.explanation: Audit logs es plural y for the last three days indica una situación repetida que llega hasta ahora; usamos have been showing.
questions.translation: Los logs de auditoría llevan mostrando intentos de inicio de sesión sospechosos durante los últimos tres días.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Result vs process
questions.question: Which update emphasizes the duration of the work rather than a completed result?
options: We have been reviewing the logs for two hours.
We review the logs every day.
questions.explanation: Have been reviewing ... for two hours pone el foco en la actividad y su duración, no en una cantidad terminada.
questions.translation: Llevamos dos horas revisando los logs.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Result vs process
questions.question: Which sentence emphasizes a completed quantity?
options: We have been reviewing endpoints all morning.
We are reviewing endpoints since noon.
questions.explanation: Have reviewed twenty-five endpoints usa present perfect simple para destacar el resultado cuantificable ya alcanzado.
questions.translation: Hemos revisado veinticinco endpoints.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Stative verb exceptions
questions.question: We ___ about this vulnerability since Tuesday.
questions.explanation: Know es un verbo de estado y normalmente no se usa en continuo; decimos have known, no have been knowing.
questions.translation: Conocemos esta vulnerabilidad desde el martes.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Stative verb exceptions
questions.question: We ___ access to the relevant logs since noon.
questions.explanation: Have, con sentido de posesión o disponibilidad, es estativo; usamos have had access, no have been having access.
questions.translation: Tenemos acceso a los logs pertinentes desde el mediodía.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · SOC improvement work
questions.question: The team ___ the workaround repeatedly today, and the results are improving.
questions.explanation: La actividad se ha repetido durante un periodo todavía abierto y muestra efectos actuales; con team usamos has been testing.
questions.translation: El equipo ha estado probando la solución temporal repetidamente hoy y los resultados están mejorando.

questions.topic: Present perfect continuous · Client questions and updates
questions.question: I ___ the incident timeline as new evidence arrives.
questions.explanation: La actualización de la cronología es una actividad reciente y continua; con I usamos have been updating.
questions.translation: He estado actualizando la cronología del incidente a medida que llegan nuevas evidencias.
